env_template.name: LITELLM_BASE_URL
env_template.description: Base URL of the litellm-proxy (OpenAI-chat-completions-compatible) endpoint the LLM writes Mermaid DSL against, e.g. https://llm-34a13a96.bunsenbrenner.org/v1

env_template.name: LITELLM_API_KEY
env_template.description: API key for LITELLM_BASE_URL - never share this value in plaintext outside your own config

env_template.name: LITELLM_DEFAULT_MODEL
env_template.description: Model name the litellm-proxy routes to, e.g. local-devstral-small2

env_template.name: PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH
env_template.description: Optional absolute path to a system Chrome or Chromium binary for puppeteer to use. If unset, wrapper.sh auto-detects google-chrome-stable, google-chrome, chromium-browser, or chromium on PATH
